subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellLevel1: Extract MainCmdXXX() function
reasons: Function extraction refactoring — extracting a block of code from ShellCommandRunXXX() into a new MainCmdXXX() function requires understanding of which code belongs to the callee vs. setup/teardown, which varies per command
Each extracted function (MainCmdExit, MainCmdGoto, MainCmdStall) has different logic bodies, so this is not a uniform mechanical transformation
Coccinelle cannot reliably express 'extract this block into a new function' as a pattern — it requires per-site reasoning about variable scope and ownership
